name: Harukaze Tomone
source:
Childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c2729]Komachi[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c2726]Yuzuna[/url] and next door neighbor of [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url]. 

[spoiler]It's Tomone who takes [url=https://vndb.org/c2726]Yuzuna[/url] to the infirmary when she has an anemia attack.

She was [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url]'s closest friend in the past because they were neighbors and they bathed together. She quickly fell in love with him.

[url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] then moved closer to [url=https://vndb.org/c2729]Komachi[/url] because they were the same age and were in the same class and because Tomone stopped taking bath with him at night, for obvious reasons.

She gave her first kiss to [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] several years ago when they were kids at a "wedding play", next to the "secret base", behind the temple.

She realized after their girl fight ( to find out who would kiss [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] first ) that her friends, [url=https://vndb.org/c2729]Komachi[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c2726]Yuzuna[/url], also liked [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] and decided to never tell her feelings for him so as not to hurt her friends.

In her route, she doesn't want to be [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url]'s girlfriend for don't hurt the feelings of [url=https://vndb.org/c2729]Komachi[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c2726]Yuzuna[/url]. She prefers to see what the future holds for them. But maybe one day ...[/spoiler]
